title: 47. 지하철에선 얌전얌전, 양보!
titleT: 47. Sit Nicely and Give Up Your Seat on the Subway!

pages.ko: 호리가 엄마랑 지하철을 타러 왔어요. 우르릉— 지하철이 들어오자 호리는 너무 신이 났지요. "우와, 지하철이다!"
pages.t: Hori came with Mom to ride the subway. Rumble— as the train pulled in, Hori got so excited. "Wow, it's the subway!"

pages.ko: 신난 호리가 노란 안전선 앞으로 쪼르르 나갔어요. 엄마가 깜짝 놀라 호리를 잡았지요. "안 돼! 안전선 뒤로!"
pages.t: In his excitement, Hori scurried right up to the yellow safety line. Mom, startled, grabbed him quickly. "No! Get behind the safety line!"

pages.ko: "안전선 앞은 위험해. 지하철이 쌩 지나가거든." 호리는 안전선 뒤로 쏙 물러섰어요. 가슴이 철렁했지요.
pages.t: "It's dangerous in front of the safety line. The train zooms right by." Hori quickly stepped back behind the line. His heart skipped a beat.

pages.ko: 지하철에 타자 호리는 또 "야호!" 외치며 뛰어다니려 했어요. 엄마가 소곤소곤. "차 안에선 조용조용, 뛰지 않는 거야."
pages.t: Once on the train, Hori shouted "Yay!" again and tried to run around. Mom whispered softly, "Be quiet and don't run around inside the train."

pages.ko: 호리는 자리에 얌전히 앉았어요. 그런데 다음 역에서 지팡이를 짚은 할머니가 타셨지요. 자리가 없어 보였어요.
pages.t: Hori sat down nicely in his seat. But at the next stop, a grandmother using a cane got on. There didn't seem to be any seats left.

pages.ko: 호리는 벌떡 일어났어요. "할머니, 여기 앉으세요!" 자리를 양보했지요. 할머니가 환하게 웃으며 "고맙구나" 하셨어요.
pages.t: Hori jumped up right away. "Grandma, please sit here!" He gave up his seat for her. The grandmother smiled brightly and said, "Thank you, dear."

pages.ko: "양보하니까 마음이 따뜻해!" 그 순간 호리 꼬리가 무지개로 반짝— 부릉부릉! 지하철에선 얌전얌전, 양보!
pages.t: "Giving up my seat makes my heart feel warm!" At that moment, Hori's tail sparkled in rainbow colors— vroom vroom! Sit nicely and give up your seat on the subway!

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리를 흐뭇하게 봤어요. "우리 호리, 정말 의젓하네!" 호리는 손잡이를 잡고 얌전히 서 있었지요.
pages.t: Mom looked at Hori proudly. "Our Hori is so grown-up!" Hori held onto the handrail and stood quietly.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 지하철에서 안전선 뒤에 서고, 조용히 하고, 양보도 잘해요. "대중교통에선 얌전얌전!" 꼬리가 또 부릉! 지하철에선 얌전얌전, 양보!
pages.t: Now on the subway, Hori stands behind the safety line, stays quiet, and gives up his seat when needed. "Be nice and calm on public transit!" His tail went vroom again! Sit nicely and give up your seat on the subway!

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리를 꼭 안아 줬어요. "우리 호리, 양보 박사네!" 대중교통에선 안전을 지키고 양보하면 모두 편안하다는 걸, 호리는 이제 알아요. 지하철에선 얌전얌전, 양보!
pages.t: Mom gave Hori a big hug. "Our Hori is a seat-sharing expert!" Hori now knows that keeping safe and giving up your seat on public transit makes everyone comfortable. Sit nicely and give up your seat on the subway!

overview.ko: 지하철에서 안전선을 넘고 뛰던 호리가 안전과 양보 예절을 배우는 대중교통 동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a public-transit story about Hori, who used to cross the safety line and run around on the subway, learning safety and the manners of giving up one's seat.

lessons.t: Follow public-transit manners such as staying behind the safety line and being quiet.
Learn the kindness of giving up your seat for others.

readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'Sit nicely, give up your seat' in a calm voice.
It's great to read this before using public transit.
